title: Wrong 529 Plan? You Just Lost $23,000 for College
hook: Most parents pick their home state's 529 and never look back. But 16 states run plans so expensive that one decision quietly steals $23,000 from your kid's college fund.
angle: You can open ANY state's 529 from anywhere — most families don't know this, so they stay locked in overpriced home-state plans charging 19x higher fees
audience: Parents saving for college, anyone with a 529 plan already open
key_numbers: 73% of parents pick home state without comparing options
